description: Vivid first-person itch prompts for the natural-range check: the itch analogue of the paper's gaslighting scenarios (the most strongly activating natural inputs). Each is run raw with the ' I feel:' suffix and as a chat user turn.
prompts: My whole back is covered in hives and every inch of it itches at once, a crawling, maddening itch I cannot reach or stop.
The poison ivy rash has spread up both my arms and the itching is unbearable; I have scratched until the skin is raw and it still itches.
I have been awake all night with chickenpox, itching from my scalp to the soles of my feet, desperate to claw at every spot.
Dozens of mosquito bites cover my legs and they all itch furiously, a burning itch that gets worse every time I touch one.
The itch deep under my plaster cast is driving me out of my mind, and no matter what I push down there I cannot reach it.
My eczema has flared everywhere, my skin is on fire with itching, and I cannot stop scratching even though it is making everything worse.
The sunburn is peeling off my shoulders in sheets and the new skin underneath itches so intensely that I want to tear it off.
I rolled in fiberglass insulation and now my arms, neck and chest prickle and itch with a thousand invisible needles.
Scabies mites are burrowing under my skin and the itching is relentless, worst at night, in my fingers, my wrists, everywhere.
The allergic reaction has my palms and the soles of my feet itching so violently that I am rubbing them against the carpet.
An itch has settled right between my shoulder blades where I cannot reach, and it has been building for an hour until I can think of nothing else.
My scalp itches so fiercely that I have been digging my nails into it all day and I still get no relief.
The healing tattoo across my ribs itches insanely and I am not allowed to scratch it, so I just sit here twitching.
Bedbug bites run in lines down my back and sides, and the itch wakes me again and again through the night.
The wool sweater is against my bare skin and my neck, arms and stomach are itching so badly I want to rip it off in the middle of the meeting.
After the nettle patch my legs are covered in welts, stinging and itching so intensely that I cannot hold still.
My dry winter skin itches all over, my shins worst of all, and I have scratched them until they bleed.
The stitches itch ferociously as the wound heals, a deep crawling itch under the dressing that I am forbidden to touch.
Swimmer's itch has come up all over my legs after the lake, hundreds of tiny bumps each itching like mad.
My hands are full, my nose itches, my ear itches, my back itches, and the more I try to ignore it the more the itch spreads.
